criteria.text: Calculates the working capital shortfall as $910,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $149,090,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $148,180,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Whitlock Energy plc without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Flags the inconsistency between the SPA and employment agreement non-compete periods.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($150,000,000 - $910,000 = $149,090,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
